sourceRefs.locator: Opening paragraphs, Materials, and Codex argenteus’ journey: likely early-sixth-century Ravenna production; material and script; leaf counts, Uppsala and the Speyer find.
Entries 1 (Codex Argenteus, Uppsala DG 1, Gospel order) and 13 (Fragmentum Spirense, end of Mark 16).
Image description, attribution and CC0 licensing; source digitisation Uppsala University Library, Alvin record 60279.

summary.de: In Italien angefertigte Evangelienhandschrift auf purpurfarbenem Pergament. Die erhaltenen Blätter befinden sich in Uppsala und Speyer.
summary.en: Gospel manuscript made in Italy on purple parchment. The surviving leaves are kept in Uppsala and Speyer.
